title: Cache upgrade crashes on startup
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the cache as the broken part, a crash due to an unrecognized config directive after the Redis upgrade.
option_titles: Rollback cache to previous Redis version
root_cause: The cache container crashes on start because its Redis 7.5 configuration file contains the directive `maxmemory-policy` at line 17, which is not recognized in this version, causing the container to repeatedly restart and the API to lose its Redis connection, resulting in 503 errors.
truth: A deploy upgraded Redis from 7.4 to 7.5; the new version refuses to start because the existing redis.conf uses a removed configuration directive, so the cache container crashes in a restart loop and the API cannot reach it.
